concepts.definition: the Islamic belief in the absolute oneness and uniqueness of Allah
the prescribed ritual prayer performed by Muslims at five appointed times each day
obligatory charitable giving from qualifying wealth for specified beneficiaries
fasting from dawn to sunset during Ramadan with the required intention and conduct
the pilgrimage to Makkah required once in a lifetime for Muslims who are able to undertake it
the sacred scripture of Islam believed by Muslims to be the revealed word of Allah
a reported account of a saying, action, or approval attributed to Prophet Muhammad
the normative example and practice of Prophet Muhammad used as guidance by Muslims
the worldwide community of Muslims united by their faith
excellence in worship and conduct expressed through sincere awareness of Allah
